name: Zendesk
description: Zendesk is a customer support platform with public APIs authenticated by OAuth or API tokens.
auth_notes: OAuth access tokens are sent as Bearer headers; API tokens are sent via Basic with email/token and are being removed (unused tokens deactivate from July 28, 2026; all stop by April 30, 2027).
gate_detail: Developer must be a verified user on a Zendesk account; OAuth clients are created by an admin on plans such as Suite Team and above or Support Team and above. No free tier or sandbox is stated.
api_scope: Zendesk APIs authenticated with OAuth access tokens, including OAuth client management, token creation, refresh tokens and PKCE support.
mcp_notes: Sources describe Zendesk's MCP client for connecting to external servers, not a Zendesk-published MCP server.
blocker_detail: Requires a Zendesk plan and an admin to create OAuth clients; API tokens are being retired.

evidence.quote: To authenticate API requests, use basic authentication with your email address and password, your email address and an API token, or an OAuth access token.
Important: Zendesk is removing API tokens as an authentication method.
You must be a verified user to make authenticated API requests.
OAuth provides a secure way for your application to access Zendesk data without having to store and use the passwords of Zendesk users.
Compare your headers to those generated by a webhook using OAuth authentication.
Zendesk is excited to announce the general availability of the MCP client

issues: Plan requirement for API access is inferred from the plan list on the OAuth article.
